summary: 昆虫用有限的感官和身体结构完成导航、飞行和越障。工程师从黄蜂、沙漠蚂蚁和蟑螂等获得设计启发，也提出仿生机器人的伦理问题。

paragraphs.brief: 昆虫的小脑如何启发机器人
sentences: A tiny insect navigates its way across featureless salt-pans.
一只小昆虫在没有明显地标的盐碱滩上辨认方向。
A cockroach successfully works out how to scramble over an obstacle.
一只蟑螂能想出办法爬过障碍。
The mantis shrimp scans its aquatic world through hyperspectral eyes.
螳螂虾以能辨别众多光谱波段的眼睛观察水下世界。

Using the most basic of equipment and brains tinier than a pin-head, insects constantly solve complex problems of movement, vision and navigation – processing data that would challenge a super-computer.
昆虫仅凭简单的器官和比针头还小的大脑，就能不断解决运动、视觉和导航难题，处理连超级计算机也会觉得棘手的数据。
How they do it is driving one of the most exciting new fields of technology – biomimetics and biorobotics, the imitation of insect systems to control man-made machines.
它们怎样做到这一切，正推动着令人振奋的仿生学和仿生机器人领域：模仿昆虫的系统来控制人造机器。
Delegates at a recent conference presented some outcomes of their work in this area.
出席最近一次会议的代表介绍了他们在这一领域工作的一些成果。
paragraphs.gist: 昆虫凭极小的大脑就能导航、越障和处理复杂视觉信息，这些能力使仿生机器人研究者希望借鉴其办法来控制机器。

paragraphs.brief: 仿黄蜂的全景地标导航
sentences: Dr Alex Zelinsky suggested that the method by which wasps use landmarks to find their way back to the nest may one day be part of a system for navigating cars that know where to go.
亚历克斯·泽林斯基博士认为，黄蜂依靠地标找到回巢路线的方法，将来可能成为汽车自主导航系统的一部分。
A research team led by Dr Zelinsky has shown that a robot can navigate its way among 50 different landmarks by recognising them individually using a panoramic camera.
他的团队已展示，机器人可用全景相机逐一辨认五十个地标，在它们之间导航。
“The inspiration came from biology, where wasps use a practical method turn back and look to orient themselves as they emerge from their nest.
“灵感来自生物学。黄蜂离巢时会回身张望，借此确定自己的方位。
By flying to and fro, they look at the wasp nest from different angles and perspectives so they can recognise it again,” he explained.
他解释道：“它们来回飞行，从不同角度观察蜂巢，因此下次还能认出它。”
The robot’s panoramic camera logs the surrounding area and its key landmarks, which are then stored in its computer according to how reliable they are as navigational aids.
机器人的全景相机会记录周围环境和主要地标，再按地标作为导航线索的可靠程度，把它们存入计算机。
The landmarks are then scaled, from small to large, so that the robot can recognise whether it is getting closer to or further away from them.
系统按地标看起来由小变大的尺度记录它们，以判断机器人是在接近还是远离。
Their location is built into a map in its mind, which operates at different scales and instructs the robot whether to turn left or right at a particular mark.
这些地标的位置汇入多尺度的内部地图，指导机器人在某个标记处向左或向右转。
The technology provides a general way for a machine to navigate an unknown landscape.
这种技术给机器在陌生地形中导航提供了一种通用方法。
paragraphs.gist: 研究者效仿黄蜂回望地标识路，让机器人用全景相机辨认五十个参照物，并按可靠性与相对大小来判断方向和距离。

paragraphs.brief: 沙漠蚂蚁的偏振光与图像导航
sentences: For three decades, Professor Ruediger Wehner has journeyed from Switzerland to the Sahara Desert where Cataglyphis, a tiny ant with a brain weighing just 0.1 mg, performs acts of navigational genius when it leaves its nest, forages for food and returns successfully.
三十年来，吕迪格·韦纳教授多次从瑞士赴撒哈拉沙漠，研究脑重仅0.1毫克的沙漠蚁如何离巢觅食并准确返回。
Cataglyphis uses polarised light, caused when air molecules scatter light, to orient and steer itself.
沙漠蚁利用空气分子散射阳光所形成的偏振光来辨别和保持方向。
Wehner’s team found that the ant has a set of specialised photoreceptors along the upper rim of its eyes that detect polarised light, while other receptors perform different navigational tasks.
韦纳团队发现，它眼睛上缘有一组感知偏振光的专门感光受体，其他受体则负责别的导航任务。
As the sun moves, the ant notes its direction each time it leaves the nest and updates its internal compass.
太阳的位置会变化，蚂蚁每次离巢都留意太阳方位，并更新体内的指南针。
Using other eye receptors it stores a snapshot image of landmarks close to the nest entrance in its eyes and compares this with what it sees as it returns.
它还借其他视觉感受器记下巢口附近地标的“快照”，回程时将眼前景象与记忆比较。
The ant also has a way of measuring distance travelled, while a path integrator periodically informs the ant of its current position relative to its point of departure.
它也有办法估计走过的距离；路径整合机制会不断算出它相对出发点的位置。
Rather than integrate all the information it receives in its brain, the ant actually performs a number of complex calculations in different organs.
蚂蚁没有将大脑中收到的所有信息整合起来，而是在不同器官中进行了一些复杂的计算。
Like a super-computer, the ant has many separate sub-routines going on simultaneously.
与超级计算机相仿，蚂蚁有多个独立的子程序同时运行。

Using the ant’s ability to steer by polarised light and to store and reuse landscape images, Wehner and colleagues have built “Sahabot,” a small vehicle that uses polarisers and a CCD camera to store 360° images of its surroundings.
借鉴沙漠蚁利用偏振光定位和存取地标画面的能力，韦纳与同事造出了名为Sahabot的小车，用偏振片和CCD相机记录周围的360度全景。
It navigates by using polarised sunlight and comparing the current images of landmarks to the ones in its memory.
它利用偏振阳光导航，将当前地标图像与记忆中的图像比较。
paragraphs.gist: 沙漠蚂蚁把偏振光、巢口景象和行程估算分给不同器官处理，科研团队据此让小车比对全景记忆，并利用偏振阳光导航。

paragraphs.brief: 仿昆虫拍翼适应火星稀薄空气
sentences: Professor Robert Michelson had a different desert challenge – to design a flying robot that can not only navigate but also stay aloft and hover in the thin atmosphere of Mars.
罗伯特·米歇尔森教授面对另一项沙漠挑战：设计既会导航，又能在火星稀薄大气中飞行和悬停的机器人。
Drawing inspiration from insect flight, he has gone beyond nature to devise a completely new concept for a flying machine.
他借鉴昆虫飞行，又超越自然界现有形式，提出全新的飞行器概念。
The “Entomopter” is a sort of double-ended dragonfly whose wings beat reciprocally.
这款名为Entomopter的飞行器宛如前后各有一套翼的蜻蜓，两对翅膀交替拍动。

Michelson says that the flapping-wing design gives the craft unusually high lift compared with a fixed-wing flyer, enabling it to fly slowly or hover in the thin Martian air – whereas a fixed-wing craft would have to move at more than 400 km/h and could not stop to explore.
米歇尔森说，与固定翼相比，扑翼设计能产生格外高的升力，让飞行器在火星稀薄的空气中慢飞或悬停；固定翼飞行器则得以每小时四百多公里的速度前进，不能停下来探察。
paragraphs.gist: 为了让飞行器在稀薄的火星大气中也能悬停，米歇尔森设计出前后两对翼交替拍动的仿蜻蜓装置，以提高低速升力。

paragraphs.brief: 蟑螂腿启发六足和轮足机器人
sentences: Engineer Roger Quinn and entomologist Professor Roy Ritzmann are taking their inspiration from cockroaches.
工程师罗杰·奎恩和昆虫学家罗伊·里茨曼教授从蟑螂身上寻找设计灵感。

According to Quinn and Ritzmann, the ability of cockroaches to run very fast over rough terrain may one day give rise to a completely new all-terrain vehicle with six legs, or maybe even wheel-like legs called “whegs.”
两人认为，蟑螂能快速跑过崎岖地面，也许有一天能启发一种全新的六足全地形车，甚至装上称为 whegs 的轮状机械腿。
The key to the cockroach’s remarkable cross-country performance lies partly in the fact that its legs do a lot of the thinking without having to consult the brain.
蟑螂越野本领的一部分秘密在于，它的腿能自行处理许多动作，无须一一请求大脑指令。

Quinn and Ritzmann are drawing on cockroach skills to create robotic walkers and control strategies that capture the remarkable capacity of these insects to traverse complex terrain and navigate safely toward goals while avoiding obstacles.
奎恩和里茨曼从蟑螂的本领出发，设计能行走的机器人和控制方法，模仿它们穿过复杂地形、避开障碍并安全抵达目的地的能力。
The team has already designed a series of robots that run on six legs or on whegs, enabling them to handle surprisingly rugged terrain.
团队已经设计出多种六足或轮足机器人，连出乎意料的崎岖地形也能应付。
paragraphs.gist: 蟑螂的腿不必事事等待大脑指令便能跑过崎岖地形，工程师据此设计出六足或使用轮足的机器人，实现越障和安全导航。

sentences: International experts believe there are tremendous opportunities in biorobotics.
国际专家认为，生物机器人方面有着巨大的机会。
However, delegates at the conference had differing visions for the future of the science.
然而，出席会议的代表对科学的未来有不同的看法。

While some were concerned that the initial applications of biorobotics may be military, others, such as Dr Barbara Webb, predicted swarms of tiny, cheap, insect-like robots as society’s cleaners and collectors.
有些人担心仿生机器人最先投入军事用途，芭芭拉·韦布等人则设想，成群微小、廉价的机器昆虫可用于清扫与收集工作。
Sonja Kleinlogel hoped the study of the hyperspectral eyes of the mantis shrimp might yield remote sensors that can watch over the environmental health of our oceans.
索尼娅·克莱因洛格尔希望研究螳螂虾的高光谱视觉，进而开发用来监测海洋生态健康的遥感装置。
Several delegates were concerned about the ethical implications of biorobotics and urged that close attention be paid to this as the science and technologies develop.
若干代表对生物机器人的伦理影响表示关切，并敦促随着科学和技术的发展，密切关注这一问题。
paragraphs.gist: 与会者既设想用昆虫状小机器人清扫、监测海洋，也担忧技术可能先进入军事用途，因此强调开发过程需同步考虑伦理后果。

items.en: positive and negative possibilities for the use of insect-inspired robots
items.zh: 仿昆虫机器人的应用可能带来的好处和坏处。
items.why: F 段并列两种应用前景：有人担心昆虫机器人优先用于军事，也有人设想用成群的小机器人清扫和收集废物。

items.en: how perceived size is used as an aid to navigation
items.zh: 观察到的物体大小如何用来辅助导航。
items.why: B 段的机器人比较同一地标在视野里由小到大的变化，从而判断自己正在接近还是远离地标。

items.en: an example of decision-making taking place in the limbs
items.zh: 一个说明肢体也能作出决策的例子。
items.why: E 段说蟑螂的腿能够自行作出不少反应，不必每次向大脑求指令，正是决策发生在肢体中的实例。

items.en: a description of a potential aid in space exploration
items.zh: 一项可能有助于太空探索的技术。
items.why: D 段的扑翼飞行器用拍翼产生较高升力，能在稀薄的火星大气中慢飞或悬停，因此可能用于行星探测。

items.en: the range of skills that have inspired biorobotics
items.zh: 启发仿生机器人设计的多种动物本领。
items.why: A 段先展示多种动物在导航、越障和视觉上的能力，再说明这些不同本领如何启发机器人的仿生设计。

items.en: how a variety of navigational methods operate at the same time
items.zh: 多种导航方法如何同时发挥作用。
items.why: C 段写蚂蚁如何在不同器官中分别处理导航线索。多个机制同时工作，并不依赖一个中央系统把所有信息先整合起来。

items.en: Which creature sees particularly well under water?
items.zh: 哪种生物在水下的视力特别好？
items.why: 定位句说：“螳螂虾以能辨别众多光谱波段的眼睛观察水下世界。”

items.en: In addition to a computer, what technical equipment is fitted in Dr Zelinsky’s robot?
items.zh: 除了计算机，泽林斯基博士的机器人还装有什么技术设备？
items.why: 机器人用全景相机记录周围环境及地标，再将信息存入计算机。题目问计算机之外还装有什么设备。

items.en: Where is the Cataglyphis ant found?
items.zh: 在哪里可以找到 Cataglyphis 属的沙漠蚁？
items.why: 原文在介绍研究者到撒哈拉沙漠考察时引出这种蚂蚁，所问地点就是 the Sahara Desert。

items.en: What atmospheric effect helps the Cataglyphis ant to know its direction?
items.zh: 哪种大气光学现象能帮助这种沙漠蚁辨别方向？
items.why: 空气分子散射光线形成偏振光，蚂蚁借它辨认方向，因此填 polarised light。

groups.label: 简答题
groups.instructionsZh: 根据原文简答。每题最多填三个词。

items.zh: 亚历克斯·塞林斯基博士
items.answer: D · a robot that categorises information from the environment according to its usefulness
items.solution: 能根据有用程度给环境信息分类的机器人。

items.answer: A · a robot that makes use of light as well as stored images for navigational purposes
items.solution: 结合光线与已储存的图像进行导航的机器人。

items.answer: F · a robot that has improved on the ability of the insect on which it is based
items.solution: 这种机器人的某项能力已经超过了它所模仿的昆虫。

items.en: Roger Quinn and Professor Roy Ritzmann
items.zh: 罗杰·奎恩和罗伊·里茨曼教授
items.answer: C · a robot that can move over difficult surfaces
items.solution: 能在崎岖地面上行进的机器人。

pairs: run very fast over rough terrain
题干用名词，定位句改用同词根的动词。
points: B 段的机器人比较同一地标在视野里由小到大的变化，从而判断自己正在接近还是远离地标。
题干问“亚历克斯·塞林斯基博士”。定位句写到“机器人的全景照相机对周围区域及其关键地标进行记录，然后根据它们作为导航辅助装置的可靠性将其储存在计算机中”。
clauses: A research team led by Dr Zelinsky has shown ….
“that a robot can navigate its way among 50 different landmarks by recognising them individually using a panoramic camera”补足 shown 的内容，交代究竟在说、判断或发现什么。
先读 shown 所在的主句，再把 that 后面的内容作为一个整体。
Wehner’s team found that the ant has a set of specialised photoreceptors along the upper rim of its eyes that detect polarised light, ….
连接词 while 引出“while other receptors perform different navigational tasks”，说明主句的时间或对比关系。
先读主句的动作，再用 while 把这一层关系补进去。
lead: A recent conference reports on developments in biorobotics
近期的一场会议介绍了仿生机器人研究的新进展。
vocabulary: 成群移动的机器或昆虫
